_about: v3.1 review item C12. One short tip per planner stop. Every tip either has official sources whose quotes scripts/check-wish-tips.mjs finds on the page (status checked), or is marked to-verify and shown with 待核实 / To verify. `evidence` = quote must be in data/evidence/<id>.json; `fetch` = page fetched by the script; `edge` = NZTA reading in docs/p10-planner.js EDGE_SOURCES.

milford.zh: 从蒂阿瑙到米尔福德峡湾的米尔福德公路（SH94）全程 120 km；2026-11-10 在 NZTA 查询车程约 1 小时 51 分（含当时路况）。
milford.en: The Milford Road (SH94) from Te Anau is a 120 km journey; NZTA Journey Planner gave 1 h 51 min on 2026-11-10 (traffic at the time).

sources.quote: 120 km journey into the heart of Fiordland National Park

rotorua.zh: 地热公园和毛利文化表演选一两处即可，多数需预订。
rotorua.en: Pick one or two geothermal parks or a Māori cultural evening; most need booking.
rotorua.why: Official Rotorua tourism site refused the automated fetch (HTTP 403) on 2026-11-10.

hobbiton.zh: 霍比特村电影片场是全程导览的步行游览，约 2.5 小时，需凭预订号取票。
hobbiton.en: The Hobbiton Movie Set tour is fully guided on foot and takes about 2.5 hours; bring your booking reference.

quote: This is a fully guided walking tour
2.5 HOURS
have your booking reference number on hand

waitomo.zh: 怀托摩萤火虫洞游览约 45 分钟，官方建议提前预订。
waitomo.en: The Waitomo Glowworm Caves tour takes about 45 minutes; the operator recommends booking ahead.

quote: Waitomo Glowworm Caves 45 mins
We highly recommend booking in advance

tekapo.zh: 特卡波可看好牧羊人教堂、泡温泉，或参加观星团。
tekapo.en: In Tekapo, see the Church of the Good Shepherd, soak in the hot pools or join a stargazing tour.

sources.quote: See the famous Church of the Good Shepherd, soak in hot pools, join a stargazing tour

kaikoura.zh: 观鲸船出海受海况影响，出发前查看运营商信息。
kaikoura.en: Whale-watching trips depend on the sea; check with the operator before you go.
kaikoura.why: The operator's home page fetched on 2026-11-10 did not state trip length or the weather policy in its text.

stewart.zh: 奥本镇周边短步道和乌尔瓦岛观鸟，可按天气安排。
stewart.en: Short walks around Oban and birdwatching on Ulva Island, arranged around the weather.
stewart.why: The DOC Ulva Island page address tried on 2026-11-10 returned 404.

catlins.zh: 沿南部风景公路看瀑布、灯塔和海岸，需要自驾。
catlins.en: Waterfalls, lighthouses and coast along the Southern Scenic Route; you need a car.
catlins.why: The pages fetched on 2026-11-10 did not name the Catlins stops in their text.

christchurch.zh: 可逛基督城植物园，或乘缆车看城市、利特尔顿港和太平洋的全景。
christchurch.en: Visit the Christchurch Botanic Gardens, or ride the gondola for views of the city, Lyttelton Harbour and the Pacific.

sources.quote: Christchurch Botanic Gardens : Christchurch City Council
The Christchurch Gondola offers spectacular panoramic views of the city, Lyttelton Harbour, Pacific Ocean and beyond

nelson.zh: 可骑塔斯曼美味骑行步道的一段；这条环线可以只骑短程或一日骑行。
nelson.en: Ride part of Tasman's Great Taste Trail; the loop can be done in short hops and day rides.

quote: Looping through the towns of Nelson, Wakefield, Richmond, Motueka and Kaiteriteri
dipped into on short hops and day rides

picton.zh: 可走夏洛特皇后步道的一段；起点船湾（Meretoto/Ship Cove）没有公路，需要乘船前往。
picton.en: Walk part of the Queen Charlotte Track; there is no road to the start at Meretoto/Ship Cove, so you need a boat.

sources.quote: There is no road to Meretoto/Ship Cove so you will need to arrange boat transport to start your walk there.

aoraki.zh: 从库克山村出发，可走胡克谷步道到奥拉基／库克山脚下，或走塔斯曼冰川观景步道（往返约 30 分钟）。
aoraki.en: From Aoraki/Mount Cook Village, walk the Hooker Valley to the foot of the mountain, or take the Tasman Glacier View Track (30 min return).

sources.quote: Walk through the Hooker Valley to the foot of Aoraki/Mount Cook on one of New Zealand’s best day walks.

wanaka.zh: 罗伊峰步道每年 10 月 1 日至 11 月 10 日因产羔关闭；关闭期间 DOC 推荐伊斯穆斯峰步道。
wanaka.en: Roys Peak Track is closed for lambing from 1 October to 10 November each year; DOC suggests Isthmus Peak Track during the closure.

quote: The track is closed for lambing from 1 October to 10 November each year.
During the Roys Peak Track lambing closure, Isthmus Peak Track is an excellent alternative.

queenstown.zh: 可沿瓦卡蒂普湖散步，或去附近的箭镇。
queenstown.en: Walk by Lake Whakatipu or visit nearby Arrowtown.

quote: nestled on the shores of the stunning Lake Whakatipu
Arrowtown, New Zealand

te-anau.zh: 可参加萤火虫洞游览，或沿蒂阿瑙湖边散步。
te-anau.en: Visit the glowworm caves or walk along Lake Te Anau.
te-anau.why: The operator page address tried on 2026-11-10 returned 404.

glaciers.zh: 可走短程雨林步道看弗朗茨约瑟夫冰川谷，或环马瑟森湖看雪山倒影。
glaciers.en: Take the short rainforest walk to view the Franz Josef Glacier valley, or loop Lake Matheson for its mountain reflections.

sources.quote: Take a short walk through the rainforest to view the Franz Josef Glacier valley.
It’s world-famous for its mirror reflections of New Zealand’s highest mountains.

haast.zh: 哈斯特隘口公路沿途有多处值得停车的短步道，可看蓝池和瀑布；留意路况。
haast.en: The Haast Pass Highway has short walks worth stopping for, to blue pools and waterfalls; check road conditions.

sources.quote: worth-stopping-for short walks to glacial blue pools, roaring waterfalls

hokitika.zh: 霍基蒂卡峡谷距镇上约 30 分钟车程，可看蓝绿色河水，有适合各种体力的步道。
hokitika.en: Hokitika Gorge is 30 min by car from Hokitika: turquoise water and walks for everyone.

quote: Hokitika Gorge is 30 min by car from Hokitika.
There’s turquoise water, lush rainforest and walking options for everyone.

punakaiki.zh: 千层岩是一条铺装短步道；喷水洞在涨潮前后最壮观。
punakaiki.en: The Pancake Rocks walk is short and paved; the blowholes are at their best around high tide.

quote: short, paved walk
They are at their best around high tide

arthurs-pass.zh: 可走魔鬼酒碗瀑布步道，穿过山毛榉林到瀑布，往返约 1 小时。
arthurs-pass.en: Walk to Devils Punchbowl Falls through beech forest, about 1 hr return.

quote: Climb through native beech forest to experience the force and thunder of Devils Punchbowl Falls.
1 hr return

abel-tasman.zh: 从马拉豪走海岸步道，可从托塔拉努伊乘水上出租船返回；预订前先核对接驳时间。
abel-tasman.en: Walk the coast track from Mārahau and take a water taxi back from Tōtaranui; check transport times before booking.

quote: From Tōtaranui you can get a water taxi back to Mārahau
We also recommend checking transport times before booking

akaroa.zh: 在海港村散步，或预订出海观赏赫氏海豚。
akaroa.en: Walk around the harbour village or book a cruise to see Hector’s dolphins.
akaroa.why: The DOC Hector's dolphin page fetched on 2026-11-10 did not mention Akaroa cruises in its text.

dunedin.zh: 可逛市中心历史建筑，或去奥塔哥半岛看野生动物。
dunedin.en: Explore the city’s historic buildings or visit the Otago Peninsula for wildlife.
dunedin.why: Official Dunedin tourism site refused the automated fetch (HTTP 403) on 2026-11-10.

oamaru.zh: 可到奥马鲁蓝企鹅栖息地参加傍晚观赏。
oamaru.en: Join the evening viewing at the Ōamaru Blue Penguin Colony.

quote: Ōamaru Penguins
Evening viewing

auckland.zh: 可乘公共渡轮去朗伊托托岛步行登顶；岛上不能过夜，别错过回程渡轮。
auckland.en: Take the public ferry to Rangitoto and walk to the summit; there is no overnight accommodation, so don't miss the ferry back.

quote: You can take a public passenger ferry or charter.
Take care not to miss your ferry. There is no overnight accommodation

bay-of-islands.zh: 可参观怀唐伊条约签署地。

coromandel.zh: 教堂湾步道往返约 1 小时 30 分，终点是著名的岩石拱门。
coromandel.en: The Cathedral Cove walk is 1 hr 30 min return and ends at the famous rock archway.

quote: 1 hr 30 min return
It ends at the iconic rock archway.

taupo.zh: 可从陶波沿怀卡托河步行到胡卡瀑布。
taupo.en: Walk from Taupō along the Waikato River to Huka Falls.

sources.quote: This walking track allows you to walk rather than drive to the Huka Falls from Taupō.

tongariro.zh: 汤加里罗高山穿越单程 20.2 km；11–4 月约 7–8 小时，5–10 月约 9 小时，5–10 月必须具备高山技能。乘接驳车或跟团须先预订步道。天气不好时不要上山，用机动日改期。
tongariro.en: The Tongariro Alpine Crossing is 20.2 km one way: 7–8 hr from November to April, 9 hr from May to October, when alpine skills are essential. A track booking is needed to use a shuttle or guided walk. Don't go up in bad weather; use a buffer day.

quote: 20.2 km one way
Nov-Apr: 7-8 hr | May-Oct: 9 hr
From May to October, alpine skills are essential for this track
A track booking is needed to use a shuttle or guided walk service.

napier.zh: 1931 年霍克斯湾地震后，内皮尔按装饰艺术风格重建；可参加装饰艺术步行导览。
napier.en: Napier was rebuilt in Art Deco style after the 1931 Hawke’s Bay earthquake; join a guided Art Deco walking tour.

quote: Following the devastating 1931 Hawke’s Bay earthquake, Napier was rebuilt in the distinctive Art Deco style
Discover the fascinating story of Napier’s heritage on a guided walking tour.

wellington.zh: 可参观蒂帕帕博物馆，或乘缆车上凯尔本，顺路去惠灵顿植物园。
wellington.en: Visit Te Papa, or ride the cable car up to Kelburn for the Wellington Botanic Garden.

sources.quote: Te Papa Museum of New Zealand
Enjoy easy access to the Wellington Botanic Garden

taranaki.zh: 塔拉纳基山天气多变，上山前查看天气预报；天气不好就选新普利茅斯海滨。
taranaki.en: Taranaki's weather is changeable; check the forecast before going up, and choose the New Plymouth waterfront if it turns.

sources.quote: has changeable and unpredictable weather. Check the forecast
